name: hd_fs30_hybrid_pilot
notes: HD^free hybrid pilot (docs/FS_PILOT.md Sec. 7): pilot E (same seed-31 starts at hd_fs30 draws, fixed dense hd_fs30 metric, fixed step size 0.025, 1 non-adapting warmup iteration, 8 vectorised chains, fast exact likelihood) plus one block-MH sweep per iteration (30 bins + 6 IRN pairs, proposals frozen in configs/m2/proposals/hd_fs30_v1.json, fitted from hd_fs30 + hd_fs30_v2_pilotE draws, never the released chain). 100 draws. Stop rule (fixed before launch): stop at the last 25-draw checkpoint ending before 2 h of wall time after launch.
